userSummary: PBZModLoader 1.0.2 and the exact public payload passed a scoped launch check: title screen, training refuge and level-30 inventory. All 391 source tests and 20 launcher checks passed. Targeted live tests confirmed the compact timer and mouse return to training. Full victories, controller behavior and full-series stability remain unverified.

compatibility.note: The installed Steam build remains 26367565; no later installed build was demonstrated. No old executable hash was available to establish binary identity.

publicManualSmoke.scope: Exact manual payload, no private documentation tour. Native game language remained French. Brief automated E and F8 inputs produced no observed menu opening; physical gameplay and controller input are not certified.

liveChanges.hud: Compact upper-right timer and counted enemy hits observed in Jagged Steel encounter. No full victory tested.

limits: Experimental preview; no fully played victory is certified by this release check.
22 active encounters retain specific manual follow-ups; historical evidence has its original build scope.
Controller behavior, haptics, all introductions and every damage-source edge case remain unverified.
Full-series stability remains unverified. One private combined tour was deliberately stopped by the 2.5 GiB available-memory guard; smaller separate launches were used afterward.
Only Steam build 26367565, the documented installation path and one local campaign profile are supported.
Public smoke did not demonstrate Inanis interaction or F8 using brief automated key presses.

screenshots.method: Actual game captures with native English language selected for a private documentation tour. Engine callbacks staged the menus. These are not screenshots of a fully played public run.
screenshots.taskbarCrop: 01 through 06 remove only the bottom 48-pixel Windows taskbar from 2560x1440 captures; 08 retains the full frame.
